% REQ: LANG-601 LANG-602 LANG-603 LANG-604 :- module(family, [parent/2, grandparent/2]). /* Facts */ parent(tom, bob). parent(bob, 'Ann Smith'). grandparent(X, Z) :- parent(X, Y), parent(Y, Z). count([], 0). count([_|T], N) :- count(T, N0), N is N0 + 1. greet(Name) :- format("Hello, ~w!~n", [Name]), atom_length(Name, Len), ( Len > 3 -> writeln(long) ; writeln(short) ), X = 0x1F, Y is X mod 7, nl. main :- findall(C, parent(_, C), Cs), length(Cs, N), N > 0, !, greet(world).
